name: Revenue, Technically
description: You delivered a thing and somebody paid for it. That is a business. Legally. Probably.
hint: Complete your first contract.

name: Certified Visionary
description: One Ascension Contract, signed and delivered. Nobody has asked what the product does yet. Keep it that way.
hint: Complete any Ascension Contract.

name: Series B Energy
description: A Tier 2 contract. You now own a whiteboard nobody is allowed to erase.
hint: Complete a Tier 2 Ascension Contract.

name: Post-Human Quarterly
description: Tier 3. The board has stopped asking about margins and started asking about souls.
hint: Complete a Tier 3 Ascension Contract.

name: Maximum Pipeline
description: Eight slots, eight modules, zero slack. Every batch is now a small industrial accident on a schedule.
hint: Fill all eight pipeline slots in one run.

name: Thirteen Digits of Nonsense
description: A trillion tokens in a single run. Somewhere, a glacier just filed a complaint.
hint: Burn a trillion tokens in one run.

name: Working Late
description: The contract came in on the last round of the year, with the investor already drafting the email.
hint: Complete a contract in the final round of the year.

name: Seven Figures, No Product
description: A million in the bank and not one shippable artefact. This is, statistically, the industry standard.
hint: Hold a million in cash at any point in a run.

name: Suspiciously Clean
description: Eight contracts, no hidden bugs. Either you are a genius or your tests are lying to both of us.
hint: Complete eight contracts in a run without shipping a single hidden bug.

name: Refuses to Leave
description: Ten rounds past the end of the year. The calendar gave up. You did not.
hint: Survive ten Endless rounds past round twelve.

name: WTF. HOW?!
description: Round one. ROUND ONE. We gave you a laptop, a bedroom and five hundred pounds, and you found the bottom of it immediately. Genuinely impressive. Never do it again.
hint: Lose a run in the very first round.

name: Datacentre Flambé
description: You cooked an entire facility. Not a laptop. A facility. The fire brigade have started referring to you by first name.
hint: Peg the heat at maximum while running Tier 3 infrastructure or better.

name: Ship It and Pray
description: Ten hidden bugs shipped in one run. You are not writing software, you are running a wildlife sanctuary.
hint: Ship ten hidden bugs in a single run.

name: Certified Landlord Victim
description: Ended the run in the red and out of the building. Your possessions are on the pavement, sorted by rarity.
hint: Lose a run with your cash below zero.

name: Six Figures of Regret
description: A hundred thousand in debt. At this scale it stops being your problem and becomes the bank's problem. Congratulations?
hint: Rack up a hundred thousand in debt.

name: Nothing Ventured
description: A whole run. Not one delivered contract. You have achieved the purest form of startup: all vision, no output.
hint: Finish a run having completed zero contracts.

name: The Yes Man
description: Fifteen contracts taken, and then it all came apart. Saying yes is not a strategy. It is a diary entry.
hint: Take fifteen contracts in one run and lose anyway.

name: Thermal Event
description: One hundred percent heat. The official term is a thermal event. The unofficial term is what the neighbours shouted.
hint: Push the rig to full heat.

name: Serial Disappointment
description: Ten failed contracts in one run. Ten separate people who now describe you, at parties, as a learning experience.
hint: Fail ten contracts in a single run.

name: Resilience, Allegedly
description: Ten runs, ten collapses. The investor deck now opens with the word "scars" and closes with the word "please".
hint: Lose ten runs across your whole career.

name: So Close, and Yet
description: You signed the Ascension Contract and then missed it. The paperwork survives. Your reputation does not.
hint: Fail an Ascension Contract you committed to.

name: Not Taking Your Money
description: Five angels turned away, nothing accepted. They are free offers. They are literally free. You okay?
hint: Decline five angel drafts in one run without ever accepting one.

name: Fire Sale
description: Three pieces of kit sold in one run. This is not downsizing. This is a hostage situation with your own hardware.
hint: Sell three pieces of hardware in one run.

name: Tightrope
description: Eight rounds deep having touched ninety-five percent heat. Every component in that room hates you personally.
hint: Reach round eight in a run that touched ninety-five percent heat.

name: Module Hoarder
description: Twelve modules owned and eight slots to put them in. The bench is now longer than the pipeline. Seek help.
hint: Own twelve modules at once.

name: Trophy Cabinet
description: Twenty awards. Most of them for things a reasonable person would hide.
hint: Earn twenty achievements.

name: Ten Runs Deep
description: Ten runs finished. You have seen every way this goes wrong and you keep coming back, which is either grit or a diagnosis.
hint: Finish ten runs.

name: Absurd, Frankly
description: A quadrillion tokens across your career. There is no comparison left. The chart is just a straight line with your name on it.
hint: Burn a quadrillion tokens across all your runs.

name: Bare Metal Purist
description: You cleared a proper office without ever touching the cloud. The invoices agree.
hint: Ascend from Office or later with zero cloud usage.

name: Somebody Else's Computer
description: Eighty percent of your throughput lived in someone else's datacentre. Your bedroom stayed cold.
hint: Ascend with at least 80% of compute in the cloud.

name: Ship It and Pray II
description: Twenty hidden bugs shipped and you still won. The postmortem is a novel.
hint: Win a run after shipping twenty hidden bugs.

name: Audit Ready
description: Five big contracts, zero bugs, quality in the nineties. The auditor cried.
hint: Complete five tier-2+ jobs in one run with no bugs shipped and quality at 90+.

name: Redline
description: You ascended with the rig pinned above ninety percent heat. The fire marshal has questions.
hint: Ascend after hitting 90% heat capacity.

name: Recursive Business Model
description: A hundred stage repeats in one run. The pipeline is a möbius strip with invoices.
hint: Trigger one hundred stage repeats in a single run.
